detail.target: Khamenei leadership compound — office of Supreme Leader, national security apparatus, Iranian Presidency complex
detail.weaponCap: B-2 Spirit stealth bomber: flies at altitude undetectable by most radar. Delivers 40,000 lb payload. Used GBU-28 bunker-busters. F-35s used simultaneously for SEAD.
detail.structuralDmg: Compound destroyed. Multiple government buildings leveled.
detail.humanCasualties: Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei KILLED. SNSC Secretary Ali Shamkhani KILLED. Multiple senior officials killed. Trump: "large amount of leadership" eliminated.
detail.launchOrigin: USS Gerald R. Ford CSG (Mediterranean) + Diego Garcia B-2 base + IDF Tel Nof Airbase
detail.misc: CIA + Israeli intelligence tracked Khamenei for months. Op codenamed "Roaring Lion" (IDF) / "Epic Fury" (DoD). Executed while top officials gathered at compound. One of most significant leadership kills in modern warfare.

detail.target: Fordow uranium enrichment facility (buried 80m underground). Natanz centrifuge halls.
detail.weaponCap: GBU-57A/B MOP: 30,000-lb penetrating bomb, only weapon capable of reaching deeply buried/hardened targets. Penetrates 60+ meters of earth before detonating. Carried exclusively by B-2.
detail.structuralDmg: Significant. IAEA later discovered hidden enriched uranium in undamaged underground facility, suggesting program not fully destroyed.
detail.launchOrigin: B-2 Spirit bombers from Diego Garcia (BIOT)
detail.misc: DoD estimated Iranian nuclear program set back 2 years after June 2025 strikes. Feb 27, 2026: IAEA confirmed Iran had hidden HEU in undamaged facility — triggered current escalation.

detail.target: Tehran main international airport - runways, ATC tower, cargo terminal.
detail.weaponCap: Rampage specifically targets airfield infrastructure - craters runways and destroys hardened aircraft shelters.
detail.structuralDmg: Two runways cratered. ATC tower struck. Cargo terminal destroyed. Airport non-operational.
detail.launchOrigin: IDF F-35I strike package via Iraq airspace
detail.misc: Iran was using IKA for IRGC resupply. Destroying it cut aerial logistics and prevented leadership from fleeing by air.

detail.target: N/A — Forward deployment for Iran strikes.
detail.weapon: 35+ F-15E Strike Eagles, 18+ F-35s, EA-18G Growlers
detail.weaponCap: Largest USAF fighter deployment to Jordan ever. F-15E: 11-ton payload, BVR missiles. F-35: stealth 5th-gen. EA-18G: electronic warfare / SEAD. New air defense installation visible in satellite imagery.
detail.misc: CNN satellite imagery + Planet Labs. 494th Expeditionary Fighter Squadron from RAF Lakenheath UK. Air defense installation expanded to protect US assets. Part of buildup described as largest since 2003.

title: South Lebanon — Demolition Campaign During Ceasefire (Apr 28-May 15)

detail.target: 120+ towns and villages across south Lebanon (ACLED count)
detail.structuralDmg: ACLED data: 120+ towns/villages hit at least once by IDF since April 17 ceasefire. Satellite imagery confirms systematic demolition in Khiam, Bint Jbeil, Mais al-Jabal, Jebchit, Beit Lif.
detail.humanCasualties: Apr 28 "double tap" strike in Majdal Zoun kills 9 including 3 emergency workers. Apr 30: 28+ killed across multiple south Lebanon strikes. May 15: Harouf airstrike kills 6+ including 3 paramedics.
detail.misc: Source: ACLED | NBC News | Reuters satellite analysis | Lebanese NNA. Israel maintains "security zone" up to ~6 miles inside Lebanon. Human rights organizations: demolition pattern is a potential war crime. Israel: necessary to prevent Hezbollah return.

detail.target: Family home outside Khan Younis; two targets in Gaza City
detail.misc: Strikes killed two brothers and a relative in their family home near Khan Younis and one person each in two Gaza City strikes, despite the US-brokered ceasefire. Source: AP https://apnews.com/article/middle-east-iran-israel-august-28-2026-6c8334dbec806f41666ff75e728768b8

detail.structuralDmg: Ship caught fire and sank; Cape Dao (hit Sept 23) also confirmed sunk.
detail.humanCasualties: GFS Pride: all 21 crew evacuated safely; Cape Dao: 1 killed at time of Sept 23 strike.
detail.misc: FOG OF WAR on cause: the Singapore-flagged container ship GFS Pride caught fire and sank in the Strait of Hormuz; Reuters sources said a projectile, while the IRGC Navy said it hit a mine on an 'unauthorized route'. The Antigua-flagged bulk carrier Cape Dao, hit Sept 23, was also confirmed sunk. RFE/RL said attacks on Hormuz shipping hit a wartime high with at least 10 ships attacked in recent days. Source: Reuters via Hawaii Tribune-Herald https://www.hawaiitribune-herald.com/2026/10/15/nation-world-news/two-ships-sink-near-hormuz-after-being-hit-by-projectiles-amid-surge-in-attacks/ ; GlobalSecurity (RFE/RL, IRNA) https://www.globalsecurity.org/wmd/library/news/iran/2026/10/10-14_index.htm ; gCaptain https://gcaptain.com/u-s-forces-destroy-iranian-linked-dhow-accused-of-targeting-navy-ships/
